patthana23.19:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana23.19:2.1: na akusalaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana23.19:3.1: na abyākataṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana23.19:4.1: na kusalaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ ca na abyākataṃ na sanidassana saṭighañca dhammaṃ pappaṭicca abyākato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana23.19:5.1: na akusalaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ ca na abyākataṃ sanidassana sappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana23.19:6.1: na kusalaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighañca na akusalaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana23.19:8.1: na kusalaṃ na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato anidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha, na kusalaṃ na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ
patthana23.19:9.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato anidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sukhāya
